summary.motive: Put the backside second-level linebacker in an inescapable run-pass conflict, punishing aggressive run fits with immediate intermediate completions.
summary.whyItWorks: Inside zone action forces Will LB to trigger into the B-gap. Because the cornerback is in off-coverage, X's sharp glance cut attacks the exact window Will vacated, giving the QB a wide-open throw before the safety can trigger.
summary.failureMode: Will LB buzzing out into the throwing lane under the glance, or boundary safety driving downhill aggressively on the slant stem.

beats.title: 11P Trips Right Alignment & Pre-Snap Conflict Read
beats.text: Reid shows the identical 11 Personnel Gun Trips Right formation. The QB identifies the backside Will linebacker as the key conflict defender in Quarters coverage.

beats.title: Inside Zone Mesh Fake & Linebacker Downhill Trigger
beats.text: The offensive line surges left on an inside zone track. The QB rides the mesh with the RB, forcing the Will linebacker to crash into the B-gap to fit the run.

beats.title: QB Pull & Rapid Second-Level Window Vacated
beats.text: With the Will linebacker sucked into the line of scrimmage, the QB cleanly pulls the ball from the mesh. A massive intermediate passing window opens directly behind the linebacker.

beats.title: Glance Delivery Behind Crashing Will LB
beats.text: X breaks sharply on his 5-step glance route at 45 degrees, cutting inside the cushion of the off-cornerback. The QB fires a laser into the vacated window.

beats.title: X Receives in Stride for Explosive YAC
beats.text: X catches the pass in full stride between the hashes, easily beating the trailing cornerback and splitting the deep safeties for a huge explosive play.

relations.tell: QB reads backside Will linebacker crashing the B-gap and pulls ball for rapid glance release to X.
